title: Frantz Fanon — Before Philosophy Got Polite #Shorts
description:
Frantz Fanon feels chosen. The evidence says it was installed. As well as an intellectual, Fanon was a political radical and Pan-Africanist, concerned with the psychopathology of colonization and the human, social, and cultural consequences of decolonization. In the course of his work as a physician and psychiatrist, Fanon supported the Algerian War of independence (1954–1962) from France and joined the Algerian National Liberation Front.

Once you see Frantz Fanon as an adaptation, the mystery mostly evaporates. Sartre agreed to write a preface to Fanon's last book, The Wretched of the Earth. With his health declining, Fanon's comrades urged him to seek treatment in the U.S. as his Soviet doctors had suggested.
